title: "Linear Regression"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Overview

This example demonstrates linear regression with an intercept term using the `aoclda` package.

```{r library}
library(aoclda)
```

## Define Data

```{r data}
X <- matrix(
  c(
    1., 2., 3., 4., 5., 6.,
    1., 3., 5., 8., 7., 9.
  ),
  nrow = 6, ncol = 2
)
y <- c(3., 6.5, 10., 12., 13., 19.)
```

## Fit

```{r fit}
lmod <- linmod$new("mse", intercept = TRUE)
lmod$fit(X, y)

coef <- lmod$coef
cat(sprintf("Coefficients: [%.3f, %.3f, %.3f]\n", coef[1], coef[2], coef[3]))
cat("Expected    : [2.350, 0.350, 0.433]\n")
```

## Predict

```{r predict}
X_test <- matrix(
  c(
    1, 2.5, 7,
    1.1, 3, 9
  ),
  nrow = 3, ncol = 2
)
pred <- lmod$predict(X_test)

cat(sprintf("Predictions: [%.3f, %.3f, %.3f]\n", pred[1], pred[2], pred[3]))
cat("Expected   : [3.168  7.358 20.0333]\n")
```
